item.title: Four Clearly Separated Flyer Blocks

turns.text: I need a 4:5 night market flyer, dark blue with warm lanterns. Exactly four separate text blocks, top to bottom: 'NIGHT MARKET', '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00', 'Old Mill Courtyard', 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'. Leave clear space between the blocks; don't add any other words.

1. **Background:** make a dark blue night scene with warm glowing lanterns, with no text at all and open space in the middle (about 5 credits).
2. **Text and shape:** reshape that image to 4:5 and add exactly your four lines, top to bottom, with clear space between them (about 5–10 credits):
   - NIGHT MARKET
   - 18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00
   - Old Mill Courtyard
   - Free entry • Everyone welcome

That's about 10–15 credits in total. AI images sometimes get letters wrong, so I'll check the text against your lines before I send you the link.

Let me know when you've added credits and I'll start.
